attchmntText: Agarwal Industrial Corporation Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Agarwal Industrial Corporation Limited approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 13, 2026. The Audit Committee also reviewed and approved the results. Revenue from operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, was 20,929.33 lakhs. Profit before tax for the same quarter was 1,508.45 lakhs. Net profit for the quarter was 1,110.98 lakhs. Earnings per equity share was 48.61. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 56,186.66 lakhs. Profit before tax was 2,750.85 lakhs. Net profit was 3,080.13 lakhs. Earnings per equity share was 157.10. The financial results include limited review reports from auditors Singhal Sanklecha & Co LLP.
